name: Claude Code v2.1.304 — Mods Get Human Gating + Code Review Levels in UI
hook: Official Anthropic (Oct 19): v2.1.304 adds `decider: "person"` and `isReadOnly` to the mod `tool.check` API — a mod can now flag specific tool calls for human approval rather than auto-block or auto-allow. Companion change: Code Review's Quick / Standard / Deep levels are now selectable directly in the UI (previously API-only). Also adds `/claude-api managed-agents-secure` as a new security audit command and expands `/auto-mode-setup` to Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry.

name: UI UX Pro Max Skill
hook: 137.5k stars. A design-intelligence skill that automatically activates on UI/UX requests and injects searchable styles, color palettes, font pairings, and UX guidelines for React, Vue, Tailwind, SwiftUI, Flutter, and more. It can also generate a full design system from a project description in one command. Already installable from the Claude Code plugin marketplace.
install: npm install -g ui-ux-pro-max-cli && uipro init --ai claude

name: diagram-design
hook: 55.1K+ stars as of Oct 14 and still the most-referenced design skill in the ecosystem. 45 diagram types rendered as self-contained HTML+SVG with no external deps — architecture delta diffs, exploded axonometric views, Wardley maps, Sankey charts, and more. v2.1.304's Code Review integration means diagrams of review-flagged changes now come with a single `/diagram` invocation.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 14 — 55K+ stars; still top design skill

name: RTK (Rust Token Killer)
hook: 84K stars, updated Oct 19. A CLI proxy that intercepts command output (logs, test results, JSON, CSV) and compresses it before it reaches your agent's context, claiming 60–90% token reduction on common dev commands. Supports Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and 15 other tools. Run 'rtk gain' after install to verify you have the right package.

name: CC Switch
hook: 146.3K stars, 9.7K forks, updated Oct 19. A cross-platform desktop app that lets you switch API providers in one click and manage MCP configs, Skills, and Prompts for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Hermes Agent — all without editing config files by hand. Available on macOS (Homebrew), Arch Linux (paru), and Windows/Linux via Releases.

name: Graphify
hook: 128.9K stars. Turns a codebase — plus docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs — into a queryable knowledge graph using local tree-sitter AST parsing. No LLM, no embeddings, no vector store. Each edge is tagged as explicit or inferred. Works as a /graphify skill inside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI. 25.4K new stars in the last 30 days.
install: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install

name: mattpocock/skills — 38 Real-Engineering Skills
hook: Matt Pocock (Total TypeScript) distilled 38 engineering disciplines — TypeScript strictness, monorepo topology, schema design, test philosophy — into a drop-in skill bundle that grew from 58.5K stars in May 2026 to 279K+ in October. ~10K weekly star gain makes it one of the fastest-compounding Claude Code skills on GitHub.

name: Superpowers — Plan-First Agentic Skills Framework
hook: Jesse Vincent's framework enforces one rule above all: Claude must propose a complete plan before writing a single line. 270K+ stars and listed on Anthropic's official Claude Code marketplace. Pairs with any skill bundle and works cross-agent (Codex, Cursor). The plan-first pattern is cited as the single biggest quality lever in practitioner guides.

name: ECC (Everything Claude Code) — Agent Harness v2.2.3
hook: 272K+ stars, v2.2.3 released Oct 1. ECC layers skills, instincts (lightweight reflexes that fire without a full skill load), long-term memory, and auto-context management on top of Claude Code. One of three repos breaking the 270K star barrier simultaneously this week alongside mattpocock/skills and obra/superpowers.

name: Orca
hook: 97.9K stars, updated Oct 19. A desktop AI orchestrator for running Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Pi side by side — each agent gets its own isolated git worktree so they can't clobber each other. Ships a mobile companion app for monitoring agents and sending follow-up instructions remotely.

name: Agent Reach
hook: 99.5K stars, updated Oct 15. A CLI that gives AI agents read and search access to Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and Xiaohongshu through one interface. Handles tool selection, installation, and health checks automatically. The 'agent-reach doctor' command reports each channel's live status.

name: Understand Anything
hook: 87K stars. A Claude Code plugin that scans a codebase (or knowledge base) and builds an interactive knowledge graph of files, functions, classes, and dependencies — navigable via dashboard, search, or natural-language questions. Includes guided code tours, diff impact analysis, and domain mapping.

name: Learn Claude Code (Harness Engineering Course)
hook: 78.8K stars, 12.6K forks. A 17-lesson progressive course that builds a nano Claude Code-like agent harness from scratch — covering tool use, permissions, hooks, task systems, and MCP integration lesson by lesson. Aimed at understanding how the harness around an LLM works, not just using Claude Code.

name: Oh My OpenAgent (omo)
hook: 70.1K stars — Day 9+ on GitHub Trending. A single `omo` command: `ultrawork (ulw)` has Claude read the codebase, plan, verify each step, and stop only when the task is done with all tests passing. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. MIT.

name: claude-code-system-prompts — Live Prompt Archaeology
hook: Updated within minutes of each Claude Code release — this repo dissects every system prompt across all 516+ tracked versions (through v2.1.304 as of today), with per-version token counts and diffs. As of v2.1.304 the system prompt has grown an additional 142 tokens since the v2.1.302 release. Useful for operators tuning CLAUDE.md around changes in the base prompt.
